tableLines.line: "Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Felix.
📓 Codex: Emberhold split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
💔 A faction of Ashford has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Amara.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
🧳 Emberhold has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table III is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Andre.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table II. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.

You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table III — 2 people, 40 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 6 plants — 6 new to you. They look lean — hungry, even. Food would talk here. They've been here the whole time.

Fresh-cut stems on the southwest ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table III's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Heinrich speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

The southwest ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. The Red Table III isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)
🧳 A traveler from southwest says The Red Table III is starving — Kira's been seen counting empty jars, and the kids have gone quiet.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table III. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
The Red Table III's speaker sent a runner: the southwest ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.
🗣️ Word with the traders: The Red Table III sent Stonebridge grain when their stores ran thin — no tribute, no ceremony, just food on the road. That's a thing villages DO now.
A runner from The Red Table III, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southwest ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)

🌙 Raid — The Red Table III came in the night from the southwest. They carried off ~800 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

🥣 Deshawn of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
Deshawn waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.

You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.

◈ OVERTIME ×2 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+50% HP, +24% damage, +1 to every pack). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −11. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock. The wait stretches — the village's standing buys time: 25 days between tiers, not 7.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and
🧳 Word of Haven’s the televised games is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: The Red Table has bound itself to Ashford. The region's map is being redrawn — not by Haven.

The little star inside Heinrich goes quiet — and wakes up inside Hideyoshi. Heinrich never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Hideyoshi will never be hungry again while it hums, and Heinrich is hungry again, for the first time in a long while. The table can hear a feast again.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
